_comment: Change set 2, app side: the published models scored side by side with the engine (checks/benchmark.mjs, checks/pair-comparison.mjs). Committed before the benchmark or pair comparison ran on the prediction files. Run under the user's instruction to proceed through every stop-gate; every value is PROVISIONAL — not ratified.
seenBeforeWriting: The research repo's own previews (reports/reproduction-cs2.md) were read before this file was written: Yu model on Eureka macro-F1 0.8305 decoded as ordinal; Yu model on Wright pairs press 0.640, abstract 0.725, pair-label agreement 0.631 (all 662 pairs); UniCausal on SSC reproduction 0.609, released 0.705; certainty-estimator Pearson r 0.678 on 331 test+ext rows; CESSC macro-F1 0.890 on 246 SSC test rows. Predictions near those numbers are not independent of them.
fixesBeforeRun: yu2020_eureka is decoded by the encoding the bundle declares (labels.encoding: yu2020-ordinal), not assumed to be yu2019's upstream codes. Before the fix, 1 (correlational) and 3 (direct causal) were swapped, which is why the engine scored 0.371 on Eureka at 1c6f4eb.
covers() learns trained_on 'original-<split>' and 'original-aspect-<split>' (the source's published split), and treats a row whose published split is unknown as covered.
sideBySide() scores a model only on rows where it supplies the label being scored; a model with none is left out and counted.

engine.otherCorpusMetrics: unchanged from engine 1c6f4eb (the fixes touch Eureka decoding and model-eligible rows only)

pei2021.aspectModel: left out of the certainty comparison (it supplies no 1–6 certainty)

engineF1.basis: precision 0.772, recall 0.473 on all 1,058 rows at 1c6f4eb gives F1 0.587

sideBySide.unscientify: no causal_register, certainty or causal label: left out of every side-by-side check (cross-checked on attribution instead, research repo)
